purpose: Enumerate possible SSH paths for phone pairing without asserting reachability from service-side evidence.
rules: OpenSSH -G is the sole source of effective service-side SSH alias configuration.
Never serialize SSH users, identities, config paths, proxy commands, environment values, credentials, or raw command output.
Candidates preserve provenance, port, address family, priority, optional expiry, and SSH host-key fingerprints.
ssh-keyscan fingerprints are untrusted observations until compared with an independently approved fingerprint.
Reject loopback, link-local, unspecified, multicast, malformed and option-like candidates.
External IP reflection, STUN, VPN, DNS and relay discovery are optional hints; no network provider is required for local use.
Only a probe originating on the Android device network can mark a candidate reachable.
Candidate ordering prefers explicit relay, VPN, stable DNS, then raw public IP candidates.
